notes: kb/Work PB5118 landed. §1985:VI.5.9.4 GR7: "An unsigned nonzero integer which is enclosed in parentheses following the symbols 'A', ',', 'X', '9', 'P', 'Z', '*', 'B', '/', '0', '+', '-', or the currency symbol indicates the number of consecutive occurrences of the symbol", and S, V, '.', CR and DB "may appear only once in a given PICTURE". PictureAnalyzer.TryExpandRepeats validates every factor (TryRepetitionFactor, COBOL2147) and, below 2002, the symbol it follows (RepeatableSymbol, COBOL7078: the list, the comma read as the period under DECIMAL-POINT IS COMMA per §1985:VI.4.5.4 GR12, and the currency symbol); PictureComposition.Validate refuses a second S, V, '.', CR or DB (COBOL1934). Witnesses: 1985-GR-VI_5_9_4-7 (each listed symbol repeated, edited as its expansion) and the refusals of 9(3)V(1)9, S(1)9(3) and 9(3)CR(1) at 85; from 2002 any symbol takes a factor (§2002:13.16.38.2 SR7; pb5118-repeat-after-any-symbol).

next.reason: Size rule same (§2023:13.18.40.4 GR4, GR14) and 'S','V','.','CR','DB' only once (§2023:13.18.40.3 SR12 b). But 1985 gives the parenthesized repeat count only 'following the symbols A , X 9 P Z * B / 0 + - or the currency symbol'; §2023:13.18.40.3 SR6 applies it to 'the symbol that immediately precedes the left parenthesis' (so S(1), V(1) and new symbols) and lets 'The integer ... be specified by a constant-name'. Pictures 1985 refuses are accepted.
